thread.title: U.S. stocks open higher, but trade still in focus

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: U.S. stocks open higher, but trade still in focus
text:
U.S. stocks opened slightly higher on Wednesday, setting major indexes up for a second straight day of modest gains, though trade continued to be the primary focus for investors. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.50% rose 0.2% to 24,327. The S&P 500 SPX, +0.27% added 0.2% to 2,729. The Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.02% climbed 0.3% to 7,586. Early trading was driven after the Trump administration said it would rely on the interagency Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States to address concerns about foreign purchases of sensitive domestic technologies. This was seen as a less aggressive stance on trade; concerns over tensions between the U.S. and China have been a primary driver of equity losses of late. Among the early gainers, Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.13% climbed 0.7% and Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -0.11% was up 0.5%.
